# [CS048] Transaction Not Rolled Back on Early Return (sql-tx-missing-rollback)

A return path leaves a transaction neither committed nor rolled back.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Reliability & Concurrency |
| **CWE** | [CWE-404](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/404.html) |
| **OWASP** | A06:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

An abandoned transaction keeps its connection and locks until the database times it out. A deferred Rollback right after Begin covers every path, and calling it after a successful Commit does nothing. Transactions returned or passed to other functions are not reported.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
tx, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
if err != nil {
	return err
}
if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, q); err != nil {
	return err // transaction left open
}
return tx.Commit()
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
tx, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
if err != nil {
	return err
}
defer tx.Rollback()
if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, q); err != nil {
	return err
}
return tx.Commit()
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [sql-tx-missing-rollback]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    sql-tx-missing-rollback: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore sql-tx-missing-rollback -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** sql-tx-missing-rollback
```
